body: The owner's question 'do you or your friends use Encore in Arabic?' is ANSWERED (6 Nov 2026, his words: some people will ask for songs in English, some in French, some in Arabic, 'think non Latin characters'). Per the earlier rule, the right-to-left part of this item moves before gate 1 (P0-14). Proposed by me, decided by the advisor on his behalf: split the item so that right-to-left (the app set to Arabic stays left-to-right today, measured 6 Nov) comes first and big text and screen readers stay where they are. Not applied yet: the board is the advisor's and the owner's to reorder.
